messages:
Ewa: quick sync on dataplane tenanting + marketplace region entitlements for Snowflake / Databricks / vector DB connectors. Need decision on region whitelist, KMS model (BYOK vs redwood-managed), and any marketplace listing restrictions for EU/UK/APAC. cc @Ben @Carla @Dinesh :wave:

Ben: question for infra/sales - do we map marketplace SKUs to hosted (shared) vs dedicated capacity? Sales needs concrete latency SLO bullets for the listing (p50/p95/p99) and a simple note on expected cross-region variance.

Carla: infra perspective: plan requires per-region VPC endpoints + per-tenant routing tables. For Dedicated offers we can provide Redwood-managed KMS; for Private (VPC/on-prem) we mandate customer-managed KMS/HSM. Need to document KMS key policies and rotation expectations for the listing. Also drafting a cross-region failover runbook (will include traffic cutover steps and cache warming).

Dinesh: legal flags: export-control matrix + updated DPA for EU/UK. We must list subprocessors and be explicit about gov data. Also check partner license terms for any carve-outs that block marketplace distribution.

Alice: GTM suggestion: phased regional announce: EU soft-launch (partner co-announce window) -> NA full launch -> APAC follow-on. Marketing needs firm embargo windows and joint PR assets before we push to marketplace.

Frank: field trial asks: need three pilot tenants (eu/us/apac), telemetry hooks (sampled query-level traces), and an agreed sanitized dataset + smoke query corpus. Partners must support query logging with upstream PII redaction. We'll publish the telemetry schema.

Ben: Snowflake notes: connector should have both a Marketplace listing and a BYOL package for self-host. Include a short external function example for partners to test onboarding: 

```
CREATE OR REPLACE INTEGRATION redwood_ext_fn
  TYPE = 'EXTERNAL_FUNCTION'
  ENABLED = TRUE
  API_PROVIDER = 'redwood_inference'
  API_KEY = '<<REDACTED>>'
  COMMENT = 'Redwood connector - external function example';
```

Ben: Databricks packaging: supply a cluster init script + wheel and include a minimal manifest. Example manifest snippet partners can mirror: 

```
{
  "name": "redwood-connector",
  "compatibility": ["13.x", "14.x"],
  "init_script": "dbfs:/init/redwood.sh",
  "notes": "gpu-hints: optional - use dedicated infer nodes"
}
```

Ewa: vector DB expectations: connectors must support batched upserts, chunked content upload, and an eviction policy doc. We'll publish perf targets for embedding lookups; partners should validate against 128-d and 768-d vectors. Provide p50/p95/p99 targets for nearest-neighbor lookups in the doc.

Carla: reality check on latencies: 20ms p50 achievable in-region with SSD caching and dedicated nodes; p95 ~30-40ms, p99 will vary (50-150ms) depending on shard distribution. Cross-region will add network RTOs; recommend we advertise region-specific SLOs on the listing. Initial EU pool sizing estimate: equivalent to 4x A10G for baseline plus burst.

Alice: action items (owners + due dates):
- Ewa: collect partner responses on KMS model, BYOK, allowed regions, and co-announce windows - due Mon EOD
- Carla: publish VPC endpoint architecture diagram + sizing + failover runbook - due Tue EOD
- Ben: provide Snowflake external function quickstart + Databricks init script + manifest templates - due Tue
- Dinesh: run DPA/export-controls checklist and surface legal blockers - due Wed
- Frank: schedule 1-week pilot and publish telemetry spec + sanitized sample dataset - due Wed

marketplace-bot: saved draft listing to staging (listing_id: staging-2024-redwood-connector). Attach certs and legal artifacts when ready.

Ewa: thanks all 44d I'll ping partners tonight and update this thread when I have confirmations.
